q: What CBAM figure should an EU buyer expect for flat steel from Eregli?
title: Eregli flat steel CBAM figure
short: A blast furnace route figure, with coke, sinter and pig iron emissions carried into every tonne of coil, usually close to 2 tonnes of CO2 per tonne. Ask the mill for its monitored figure. A Turkish carbon price can be deducted only once it is actually paid.
audience: EU importers of hot-rolled, cold-rolled and coated coil from Eregli and the Black Sea coast

ul: Precursors made on site: sinter, pig iron and crude steel.
Direct emissions at the rolling and coating lines.
Not electricity, which is outside the charged figure for steel.

p: Cold-rolled and galvanised coil add their own furnace gas and carry the hot-rolled coil as a precursor. Ask for a figure per product, not one number for the whole site.
Turkey has legislated an emissions trading system starting with a pilot phase. A deduction from the CBAM charge needs a price effectively paid, net of free allocation, with evidence.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.
